Current State: Policies exist but annual review evidence is incomplete
Gap Identified: Security policies are not reviewed and approved on a consistent annual schedule
Business Impact: Outdated policies may not reflect current business or security requirements
Recommended Remediation: Establish an annual policy review cycle and retain approval evidence

Current State: Security responsibilities exist but are not fully documented
Gap Identified: Cybersecurity ownership and accountability are unclear across departments
Business Impact: Unclear ownership may delay incident response or remediation activities
Recommended Remediation: Create a formal cybersecurity RACI matrix with accountable owners

Current State: Risk ownership is documented for some but not all risks
Gap Identified: Some High and Medium risks do not have clearly assigned owners
Business Impact: Risks may remain unresolved because no individual is accountable for treatment
Recommended Remediation: Assign a risk owner to every High and Medium risk

Gap Identified: Formal approval and documentation are not consistently retained for accepted risks
Business Impact: Management may lack visibility into accepted cybersecurity exposure
Recommended Remediation: Create a documented risk acceptance workflow with approval requirements

Current State: Vendor assessments occur but reassessment is inconsistent
Gap Identified: High-risk vendors are not consistently reassessed
Business Impact: Vendor control weaknesses may introduce unmanaged cybersecurity risk
Recommended Remediation: Implement annual reassessments for high-risk vendors and track remediation

Current State: Compliance responsibilities are only partially documented
Gap Identified: A complete compliance obligations register with accountable owners does not exist
Business Impact: Regulatory or contractual requirements may be overlooked
Recommended Remediation: Create and maintain a compliance obligations register

Current State: Role-based access controls are implemented but reviews are inconsistent
Gap Identified: User access is not recertified on a consistent schedule
Business Impact: Users may retain unnecessary access to sensitive systems or information
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly access reviews and remove unnecessary permissions

Current State: Vulnerability scanning occurs but some findings exceed remediation targets
Gap Identified: Severity-based remediation timelines are not consistently enforced
Business Impact: Known vulnerabilities may remain exploitable longer than acceptable
Recommended Remediation: Enforce severity-based remediation SLAs and document approved exceptions

Current State: Detection rules exist but formal coverage reviews are inconsistent
Gap Identified: Detection capabilities are not systematically reviewed for monitoring gaps
Business Impact: Threat activity may go undetected because important use cases are missing
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly detection coverage reviews and document identified gaps

Current State: Tabletop exercises are not performed consistently
Gap Identified: Incident response procedures are not validated through recurring exercises
Business Impact: Teams may respond slowly or inconsistently during a real cyber incident
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual tabletop exercises and track corrective actions

Current State: Backups are performed but restore testing is inconsistent
Gap Identified: The organization lacks consistent evidence that backups can be successfully restored
Business Impact: Recovery may fail during ransomware system failure or disaster
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly restoration testing and document recovery results
